verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a REST API for managing data and connecting external services, so issuing API credentials is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence describes scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API tokens. Tax-adviser collaboration access is a user-invite feature, not scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
